name: valve_ep2_pit_trap
note: EP2's plank pit trap (ep2_outland_03): a 192-square timber mine shaft through a mine room's floor, its mouth covered by a lid of nine boards hinged along one long plank, with two loose planks on top; a crate on it as bait. Step on it and it creaks; step off (or along it) and the loose planks break, the long plank slides down the shaft on a slide constraint, the boards swing down on their hinges and whoever stood there drops 250 to the beam ring; a ladder leads out

trigger.name: pit_trap_wake_rl_1
trigger.what: wakes the boards (a step on the lid does it)

trigger.name: pit_trap_break_rl_1
trigger.what: drops the lid, after the wake
